blind_spots.blind_spot: Claims to be 'optimized for contested or low-connectivity environments' but never describes the actual bandwidth budget or degraded-mode architecture for a platform whose core feature is live imagery/video/3D-reconstruction fusion.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A 2D/3D visual-fusion pipeline is bandwidth-hungry by nature; without a stated frame-rate-decoupling or store-and-forward design, the same 30fps-crowd-detection failure mode applies — the pipeline that worked at Camp Grayling stalls the moment the link degrades to true DDIL.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Northern Strike 2025 is a large, well-resourced joint exercise with strong comms infrastructure — a demo win there doesn't prove the architecture survives an actually denied link.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Renders at Speeds optimized for contested or low-connectivity environments.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR/STIG language anywhere despite claiming 'mission-proven technology' and 'commercial satellite support' demonstrated at a National Guard/DoD exercise.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Moving from a Northern Strike demonstration to a fielded program requires an Authority to Operate on government networks and a CMMC posture; a visual-fusion tool that ingests satellite and sensor feeds is exactly the kind of system that stalls at the compliance gate, not the technical one.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Public voice is still press-release/demo-win framing ('breakthrough,' 'groundbreaking') rather than acquisition-transition framing.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Field deployment highlights Larx's mission-proven technology, commercial satellite support, and groundbreaking 3D reconstruction workflow for operational advantage.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Launched a UK/EMEA subsidiary and international GTM push while the flagship U.S. defense proof point is still a single named exercise (Northern Strike), not a program of record.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A ~10-15 person team splitting focus across international expansion before the core DoD transition is locked in is the classic stage-pressure pattern: months-to-field keeps ticking on the domestic opportunity while headcount gets pulled toward new-market GTM.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Press-release cadence (UK launch, Northern Strike demo, both within the last year) signals a team optimizing for visible momentum over transition risk management.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: New UK subsidiary strengthens international presence and accelerates delivery of decision intelligence capabilities across UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa

opener_hook: Larx's Northern Strike 2025 demo at Camp Grayling showed live 3D reconstruction from commercial satellite feeds — what's the bandwidth budget when that link goes from exercise conditions to real DDIL?
what_they_do: AI-native visual/geospatial decision-intelligence platform fusing imagery, video, drone, and satellite feeds into a real-time 2D/3D operational picture for defense and commercial customers.
